title: Course & Content Creator, Virtual Assistant & Marketing
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, self-motivated Virtual Assistant to assist in the creation of online courses and ebooks focused on the in-home care business. The ideal candidate will have experience in content creation, research, click funnel creation and familiarity with course development tools. This role requires strong organizational skills, excellent communication, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. This role requires efficient time management and must complete task in a timely manner. We are a growing in-home care agency dedicated to providing exceptional services to elderly and disabled clients in the comfort of their homes. We are also seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Virtual Assistant to support our day-to-day operations, manage documentation, and assist in the creation of online educational content for our training programs. Someone who is efficient with task and intuitive at problem solving. Hours may increase to Full Time with pay increases if Assistant is performing at a high level in all areas.



Key Responsibilities:



Administrative Support



Customer & Employee Support (Phone Skills Required)



Draft and format documents in Microsoft Word



Create and manage spreadsheets in Excel (logs, reports, tracking tools)



Organize and maintain digital filing systems (e.g., Google Drive, Dropbox)



Assist in preparing monthly/weekly payroll reports



Data entry and light bookkeeping



Google Review monitoring and retention



Schedule and coordinate virtual meetings or team check-ins



Reporting & Payroll Assistance

Compile caregiver hours and logs for payroll processing



Generate and update weekly performance or compliance reports



Assist with vendor payment logs and invoice tracking



Online Course Development

Help with structuring and uploading course modules



Assist in managing an LMS (Learning Management System) like Teachable, Kajabi, or Thinkific



Coordinate updates and materials with content creators



Monitor enrollments, feedback, and engagement analytics



Communication & Client Support

Respond to
s and follow up with caregivers, clients, or vendors



Manage internal communication channels (Slack, Microsoft Teams, etc.)



Draft company announcements or internal memos



Software & Tools You Might Use

Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook



Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Forms)



Zoom / Microsoft Teams



QuickBooks (or other bookkeeping software)



Teachable, Thinkific, or Kajabi (LMS platform)



Asana, ClickUp, or Trello (task/project management)



Requirements:

Proven experience as a virtual assistant or admin role



Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel and Word)



Excellent written and verbal communication skills



Strong attention to detail and organizational skills



Comfortable with learning new software platforms



Prior experience in healthcare or home care industry is a plus



Knowledge of payroll reporting or course management is a bonus



Research and compile information on in-home care regulations, best practices, and industry trends.



Develop and write content for online courses, including modules, lessons, and assessments.



Create and format ebooks in various formats (PDF, ePub, Kindle).



Design visual elements such as infographics and charts to enhance learning materials.



Utilize Learning Management Systems (e.g., Teachable, Thinkific) to upload and organize course content.



Edit and proofread all materials to ensure clarity, accuracy, and consistency.



Collaborate with the team to brainstorm and implement engaging educational strategies.



Manage project timelines and ensure timely delivery of all content.



Qualifications:

Proven experience in content creation, particularly in educational materials.



Strong research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.



Proficiency in using course development tools and LMS platforms.



Basic graphic design skills using tools like Canva or Adobe Express.



Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.



Highly organized with strong attention to detail.



Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.



Familiarity with the in-home care industry is a plus.



Working Hours:

Flexible hours with the expectation of meeting project deadlines.



Regular check-ins and updates via communication tools.



Salary:

Competitive, based on experience, qualifications and performance.



Work Hours

Must be available 10:00AM to 2:00PM EST business hours (Graveyard Shift) & (2)Flexible Hours in the evenings/weekends Totaling 30- 40+ Hours Per Week



How to Apply:

Please submit the following:





If you feel like this you're a good fit for this position, please make an AUDIO APPLICATION and upload to dropbox, google drive or other cloud platform and answer the following questions:

-What is your past experience?

-Are you ok with working the Graveyard Shift? We operate during Eastern Time Zone.(9am -5pm)

-What is your home situation like?(family, kids, etc...)

-Home Office

-Internet Speed?

-Possible Distractions?(family, kids, etc...)

-Are you immediately available for Full-Time Work?

-We pay anywhere from $5-$8 based off of experience and performance.

-Your updated resume.

-Samples of previous content creation work (e.g., course materials, ebooks)







**Put a link to the Audio File in your application. Applications without an Audio File and Previous Projects will NOT be considered!!**



We look forward to collaborating with a dedicated professional who is passionate about creating impactful educational content in the in-home care sector.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:

Because we are currently in the startup and growth phase, this role offers a unique opportunity to help build the company's operational foundation while growing into a key member of our administrative team.

The Virtual Assistant will provide comprehensive administrative and operational support across multiple areas of the business. This role requires someone who is highly organized, resourceful, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities independently.

The ideal candidate enjoys creating systems, maintaining organized records, improving processes, conducting research, and supporting business growth through efficient administrative management.

Strong internet research and lead generation skills.

Familiarity with CRM systems and database management.

Basic understanding of social media management and digital marketing.

Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple projects, and consistently meet deadlines.

High attention to detail, professionalism, and discretion.

We are looking for more than a Virtual Assistant—we're seeking an operations partner who enjoys building organized systems, solving problems, and helping a growing company scale successfully. The ideal candidate is proactive, resourceful, dependable, and committed to delivering high-quality work with minimal supervision.

We value individuals who take initiative, communicate effectively, and are comfortable recommending process improvements that increase efficiency and support long-term business growth.



Opportunity for Growth

As our company expands into additional markets and increases its client base, this position is expected to grow in responsibility and leadership. We are committed to investing in individuals who demonstrate initiative, accountability, and a desire to grow with the organization. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to take on expanded operational responsibilities and play an integral role in the continued success of our company.

title: SEO Blog Content VA (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
[SEO Blog Content VA | $9–14/hour depending on experience | Part-Time, Remote]



Job Overview

We are a direct-to-consumer eCommerce brand in the automotive accessories space. We are looking for a

detail-oriented VA to support our SEO blog content production.



We have a structured content system already in place. You do not need to come up with content ideas,

choose keywords, or make publishing decisions. Your job is to follow the system accurately, run the

brief, review the output carefully, resolve every flag, and submit clean work.



This is an execution and quality-control role. Attention to detail matters more than writing ability.



Responsibilities

• Receive a keyword assignment with a confirmed product page link

• Research secondary keywords and competitor URLs using Google

• Fill in the brief template and run it through our AI content system (Claude)

• Review the full output against a QA checklist before submitting

• Resolve every open flag in the output, or note clearly why it could not be resolved

• Submit organized work with metadata options labeled and open questions listed

• Target: 3-5 posts per week depending on post type



Requirements

• Comfortable using AI tools, specifically Claude, and following structured prompt systems

• Strong attention to detail: you read checklists fully and catch errors others miss

• Basic understanding of SEO concepts: meta titles, meta descriptions, internal linking, search intent

• Clear written English: you follow instructions exactly and flag ambiguity rather than guess

• Reliable turnaround: primary post type within 24 hours, longer posts within 48 hours

• Familiarity with Sanity CMS or similar platforms is a plus but not required



Hours: up to 40 hours/week depending on workload.



Compensation

• Starting rate: $9–14/hour depending on experience

• Candidates who demonstrate clean output, fast turnaround, and low error rates will be considered for a rate increase after the first 30 days.



How to Apply

Please submit your application through the OnlineJobs.ph messaging system.

To confirm you have read this posting carefully, start your message with the word "COVERLAND-READY" on the first line. Applications that do not begin with this word will not be reviewed.

Your message must include:

• The word "COVERLAND-READY" as the first line

• A brief note on your background and why this role fits (3-5 sentences)

• One example of content QA, editorial, or checklist work you have done

• In one sentence, explain the difference between a meta title and a meta description

• Confirmation that you are comfortable using Claude or a comparable AI writing tool

• Your resume/CV



We will review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates about next steps, which will include a short skills test.



Thanks.

The goal is to make videos that people genuinely want to watch while also making the brand, lifestyle, behind-the-scenes process, and products look cool, elevated, and intentional.



- The videos will focus on:



* Building a clothing brand

* Behind-the-scenes of shoots, drops, travel, production, and creative direction

* Lifestyle and brand-building 
nts

* Product storytelling

* Luxury/streetwear brand energy

* Creative process

* Travel, events, and important brand 
nts

* The work, grind, and effort behind building something real



The video should not feel like a boring documentary. It should feel like a premium cinematic YouTube video with vlog-style personality, music, visuals, captions, story, and energy.



- Video Length

Final long-form videos will usually be around 20–25 minutes.



Each project may include 5–8 hours of raw footage, so you must be good at reviewing footage, selecting the best 
nts, finding the story, and cutting out anything that does not add value.



- Editing Style

We are looking for someone who can create:



* A clear storyline

* Cinematic visuals

* Strong music selection

* Fast but intentional pacing

* Premium color grading

* Clean sound design

* Captions throughout the full video

* Text overlays where needed

* Motion graphics

* AI-assisted effects/enhancements when appropriate

* Strong transitions

* Emotional/dramatic 
nts when needed

* Fun, upbeat 
nts when needed

* A video that feels curated, not random



The final video should feel premium, entertaining, and easy to watch.



- Responsibilities

You will be responsible for:



* Editing cinematic long-form YouTube videos

* Reviewing 5–8 hours of raw footage per project

* Creating a 20–25 minute final YouTube video

* Building the story from a rough outline

* Choosing the strongest 
nts and removing weak footage

* Creating a strong opening/hook

* Adding music, sound effects, and sound design

* Adding captions throughout the full video

* Adding text overlays and motion graphics when needed

* Color grading the footage to make it feel premium

* Cleaning up audio when needed

* Using AI tools for visual effects, cleanup, enhancement, motion, or workflow when appropriate

* Creating 3–5 full YouTube thumbnail options

* Creating 3–5 strong YouTube title options

* Creating a YouTube trailer reel that summarizes the full video

* Creating one reel that is also featured inside the YouTube video

* Pulling additional short-form clips from the video if there are strong 
nts worth posting

* Helping with creative direction before shoots when needed

* Helping with shot ideas, story structure, and planning so the footage is easier to edit into a strong final video



- Deliverables Per Project 

Each project should include:



1. One full 20–25 minute cinematic YouTube video

2. Full captions throughout the video

3. 3–5 YouTube thumbnail options

4. 3–5 YouTube title options

5. One trailer reel summarizing the full video

6. One reel that is included or featured inside the YouTube video

7. Additional short-form clips if there are strong 
nts worth clipping

8. A short explanation of the creative direction/story approach used for the video



- Creative Direction

We will provide a rough outline, product names, brand notes, important context, and any key 
nts that need to be included.



However, we need someone who can take that rough outline and build the actual story.



You should be comfortable giving creative input before shoots, including shot ideas, structure, 
nts to capture, transitions, and ways to make the video more cinematic and engaging.



We want someone who can help make the final video better, not just follow instructions.



- Software Requirements

PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ONLY EDIT IN CAPCUT

You should be experienced with professional editing software such as:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* After Effects

* Final Cut Pro



- Color Grading

Color grading is extremely important for this role.



You must be able to make footage look premium, cinematic, and polished. Please be prepared to show before-and-after examples of your color grading work.



- AI / Visual Effects

Experience with AI tools is a plus.



We are interested in editors who can use AI tools for enhancement, cleanup, effects, motion, rotoscoping, upscaling, workflow, or creative visual effects.



We are not looking for fully AI-generated videos. The real footage should still be the foundation.



- Schedule / Turnaround

This will be a per-project role.



We will likely need one major cinematic YouTube video edited once per month or once every other month.



Turnaround time is maximum 2 weeks per project, including revisions.



Because these are larger cinematic projects, attention to detail, patience, and precision are very important.



- Pay

Pay is per project and will be based on experience, quality, and the full scope of the project.



This role pays higher than a standard vlog editing role because the videos are longer, more cinematic, and require more creative direction, color grading, captions, thumbnails, title options, trailers, and short-form deliverables.



- Requirements

You should have experience with:



* Cinematic YouTube editing

* Long-form storytelling

* Luxury/lifestyle-style video editing

* Music selection

* Sound design

* Captions

* Motion graphics

* Color grading

* YouTube pacing and retention

* Thumbnail creation

* YouTube title strategy

* Creating reels/short-form clips from long-form footage

* Working with large amounts of raw footage

* Building a story from a rough outline

* Helping with creative direction before shoots



- How To Apply

To apply, please send:



1. Your resume or a short summary of your experience

2. Links to cinematic long-form YouTube videos you have edited

3. Links to brand, lifestyle, fashion, travel, or cinematic videos you have edited

4. Before-and-after examples of your color grading

5. Examples of thumbnails you personally created

6. Examples of YouTube titles you created or helped recommend

7. A 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and walking through one cinematic project you edited

8. In the Loom, explain your timeline, color grade, sound design, music choices, story structure, and creative decisions

9. Your editing software

10. Your computer specs

11. Your internet speed

12. Your usual turnaround time for a 20–25 minute cinematic YouTube video

13. Whether you are comfortable helping with creative direction before shoots

14. Examples of any AI tools or visual effects you have used in past edits



Put the word “CINEMATIC” in your subject line so we know you read the full post.



Generic applications will be ignored. We are looking for someone who can help create premium cinematic YouTube videos that feel intentional, engaging, stylish, and worth watching.

description:
Patient Communications, Insurance & Scheduling Specialist — Premium California Eye Care Practice

We are a respected optometry practice in Santa Monica, California, and we are growing fast. Over the next few years we are expanding significantly, and we need someone exceptional to grow with us from the start.

This is not a generic VA role. It is a long-term career opportunity for someone who takes real pride in their work, communicates beautifully in English, and wants to be part of a team that holds itself to a genuinely high standard.



About the role:

You will be the first voice our patients hear and the person who keeps our schedule full and our patients well taken care of. You will handle inbound and outbound calls, respond to patient texts and
s, schedule and confirm appointments, fill cancellations proactively, process insurance verifications, handle billing reconciliation, and follow up with patients for recalls and outstanding needs. You will work with a team of VAs, as well as our in-office team. We expect you to be on Zoom and available to communicate with our team throughout the workday.



More importantly, you will think. When you see something that could be done better, you will say so and help us fix it. When a phone shopper calls unsure whether to book, you will make them feel so welcome and confident in us that they do. When a patient has a confusing insurance question, you will walk them through it with patience and clarity.

We want someone who takes ownership of their work the way a small business owner does.



What we are looking for:

You speak and write English fluently with a neutral accent. Patients on the phone should feel immediately at ease with you. You have outstanding attention to detail, especially when it comes to patient records, insurance processing, and scheduling accuracy. You are warm but efficient. You follow through on everything. You do not need to be reminded twice.

Experience in healthcare, medical or dental offices, optometry, or insurance is a strong advantage. If you have worked in a patient-facing scheduling or billing role before, tell us about it. Prior VA or remote work experience is preferred.

We are specifically looking for someone who is growth-minded. The person who excels in this role will take on more responsibility over time, help train others, and become a key part of how this practice operates. We reward people who perform.



Compensation and schedule:

Starting pay is $5.00 USD per hour. Full-time hours required. You must be available during California business hours, Tuesdays to Saturdays. Performance bonuses are available for top performers. This is a stable, long-term role with an employer who genuinely invests in their team.

 send all four of the following or your application will not be reviewed:

1. your resume.

2. a voice recording of 60 to 90 seconds introducing yourself in English. This is how we evaluate communication quality. Please do not skip this.

3. a short paragraph describing a time you improved a system or process at a previous job. What was the problem, what did you do, and what changed?

4. a screenshot of your internet speed test from speedtest.net and a brief description of your computer setup.

We review every application personally. If you are sharp, dependable, warm with patients, and ready to be part of something that is genuinely growing, we would love to hear from you.

title: Meta & Social Platform API Specialist (OAuth / Graph API)
description:
A fast-growing SaaS company is looking for a specialist to own the health of our social media automation integration — specifically Meta's Graph API and OAuth 2.0 token layer for
 and Instagram.



The system was built and running, then broke at the OAuth/API integration layer. Posting, reposting, and automated comment actions are currently failing. This is not a "figure out the basics" role — it's a diagnose-and-fix role for someone who has lived inside Meta's developer ecosystem and knows exactly where these integrations tend to break.



This starts as a defined fix engagement. If the integration is stable after 30 days, this converts to an ongoing monthly retainer.



What you'll work on:

Diagnosing and resolving current OAuth token/authentication failures on
 and Instagram automation

Meta App Review, permissions scopes, and webhook subscriptions

Long-lived token refresh flows and account reconnection handling

Ongoing monitoring so integrations don't silently break again

TikTok API familiarity is a plus, not a requirement



What you bring:

Hands-on production experience with Meta Graph API and OAuth 2.0 (not tutorial-level — shipped, maintained integrations)

Experience with Meta App Review / Business verification processes

Comfortable reading API error logs and webhook payloads to isolate root cause

Node.js or similar backend experience to implement fixes, not just diagnose them



Application questions:

1. Describe a Meta/Facebook API integration you've built or maintained. What broke, and how did you find the root cause?

2. Have you been through Meta's App Review process? What was the hardest permission to get approved?

3. When a long-lived access token stops working with no visible error, what's your first move?

4. Some engineers prefer fixing what's broken; others prefer rebuilding it clean. Which are you, and why?



Top 3 Skills we are looking for:
 Graph API, OAuth 2.0, Meta App Review

Additional skills: Instagram API, Webhooks, Node.js, API Debugging, TikTok API, REST APIs



Let us know which skills you possess! 



Thanks

Our company builds a self-guided sleep therapy application available on both iOS and Android, allowing patients to receive treatment directly through their phones. We're hiring a customer support specialist to join our growing remote team based in the Philipines, first on a part-time trial basis, then depending on performance, converting to a full-time role.

s through our Help Center, which runs on Zoho Desk, and passing anything along to the team that needs escalation. Day-to-day, you can expect to:

s and knowledge base updates will come from you (with or without AI help)

 rather than attached — and make sure it speaks to at least three of the qualities listed above. Attach your CV and include a link to your LinkedIn profile.

s. We value persistence, so send a follow-up within 24 hours of your first message — doing so triples your odds of hearing back.

title: Amazon PPC / Advertising Specialist
description:
Amazon PPC Specialist - Pax Distribution



We manage Amazon end-to-end for premium brands. You'd run the ad accounts day to day. Build the campaigns, read the data, kill what's not working, double down on what is.



This isn't a set-it-and-forget-it seat. We don't manage everything to one ACoS number and call it a day. Every campaign has a job, and the job d
 the metric. A rank-building campaign gets judged differently than a profitability one. If that made sense to you, keep reading. If it didn't, this isn't your role.



What you'd actually do





Build and manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display across several brands

Structure campaigns so our own products don't bid against each other



Own the negative keyword work. This is where most people get lazy and it's where accounts quietly leak money

Read Search Query Performance and Brand Analytics, and tell me which terms we can actually win and which we can't

Know when to stop spending, not just when to spend



You're a fit if



You think in terms of what a campaign is for, not just its ACoS

You'll tell me a keyword isn't worth it even when it looks good on paper

You get that sometimes the fix is the reviews or the listing, not more ad spend

You treat a budget as a ceiling, not a quota to hit



You're not a fit if



You manage everything to one blended ACoS target

You think more spend is always the answer

You need to be told what to do every day

You can't explain why you made a bid change





To apply



Don't send me a résumé full of "increased sales by X%." Send me this:



Tell me about a time you told a client or a boss to spend less, or to not run something at all. What was it, and why were you right? Two short paragraphs. No fluff.



If you can't think of one, you haven't done this long enough for what we need.

mber who understands the current workflow

title: INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR OPPORTUNITY — REMOTE Digital Marketing & HubSpot Strategist — B2B North America | US Market Refer
description:
Who We Are



Connex Partners is a US-based concierge consultancy and executive peer network serving mid-to-large enterprise employers in HR and US healthcare. We have been building and running senior peer communities since 2006 and are expanding rapidly in 2026. We also publish Inside CHRO, an editorial platform read by senior HR executives across North America. Our audience is C-suite and VP-level decision makers at major US organizations — and we need a sharp, self-directed marketing contractor to help us reach more of them.



The Role



This is a broad, strategic marketing contract with real ownership. You will be largely self-managing, reporting into our Head of US Marketing, and expected to bring both strategic thinking and hands-on execution to everything you touch. If you need to be told what to do next, this is not the right engagement. If you can look at a set of channels, a CRM, and a target audience and independently build a plan that drives inbound leads — we want to hear from you.



Scope of Contract Work



Conceptualize, build, and execute HubSpot campaigns across the full platform — workflows, sequences, landing pages, forms, and reporting. Develop and implement social media strategy and manage posting across LinkedIn, YouTube, and the Connex website. Drive inbound lead generation through SEO strategy and execution, with working knowledge of GEO — Generative Engine Optimization — to ensure Connex content surfaces effectively in AI-driven search environments. Optimize all channels continuously, using data to identify what is working and improve what is not. Support graphic design needs where required — strong visual communication skills are a genuine advantage. Collaborate closely with the US-based Head of Marketing to align all activity with broader business goals and campaign priorities.



The Profile That Succeeds Here



You have real, demonstrable experience across digital marketing — not surface-level familiarity. You have built and managed HubSpot campaigns before and you understand the platform deeply. You think strategically about how channels work together to generate inbound pipeline, and you can execute against that strategy without hand-holding.



Specific requirements:



Proven experience in digital marketing with a strong working knowledge of HubSpot, LinkedIn, YouTube, SEO, and GEO. Experience building inbound lead generation programs, not just managing content calendars. The ability to work largely autonomously — you manage your own priorities, your own output, and your own quality bar. Excellent written and spoken English — your work will be seen and read by senior US executives and must reflect that standard. Some graphic design capability is a meaningful advantage. Experience in US B2B marketing — particularly in the HR, Human Capital, or US Healthcare sectors — is a strong differentiator and will be weighted heavily in our review.



Compensation & Advancement



Contracted engagement value equivalent to $6–$12 USD per hour of output, structured as agreed project and deliverable fees.



Performance bonuses tied directly to inbound lead generation and campaign results.



Full work-from-home schedule flexibility — you are measured on outcomes, not hours logged.



Long-term contractor engagement with a stable, rapidly growing company and real scope to grow the role as Connex expands.



How to Apply



Send the following to 
 with the subject line PH-MKTG-01:



Your resume as a PDF, including examples of campaigns or work you have owned and delivered.



A short note — no more than a few sentences — on one thing: why you specifically are the right person for this contract. Not a generic cover letter. Just the single most compelling reason we should speak with you first.



We respond quickly to strong applicants.



This engagement is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contractors are solely responsible for their own taxes, statutory contributions, benefits, and full compliance with all applicable laws in the Philippines, including BIR registration requirements and any applicable local government permits. This is not an offer of employment. Connex Partners does not direct the means or methods by which contractors perform their services. Nothing in this arrangement creates or implies an employer-employee relationship.

, and direct bookings

Work Setup

Remote, full-time, 2 days off per week. 9-hour shift within the 7AM–8PM PST window (exact shift set at hiring). [
a month paid bi-weekly depending on experience], performance raises reviewed at 90 days.

HOW TO APPLY — read carefully, incomplete applications are auto-rejected

Start your application with the word LIGHTHOUSE so we know you read this posting.

Our hiring process has three stages: this written application, an unscheduled live video call where we work through operational scenarios together in real time, and a paid trial shift. Your written answers will be verified in detail on the live call — only apply with real experience, because invented details do not survive stage two. We screen for AI-generated responses and disqualify them.

1. Your actual experience — state facts, we will verify them

* Maximum number of units you handled AT THE SAME TIME (not cumulative), and for how long

* Which markets/states, and which PMS/channel manager you used daily

 WITHOUT permission and what your fallback is if your first fix fails. (Finalists will solve a live variation of this on camera.)

4. Systems example: Describe, in this numbered format:

Applications that skip the keyword, answer the scenario with "I would contact the owner," or give generic answers with no specific details will not receive a response.

title: Video Editor for Daniel Moncada & His Team of Streamers
description:
Help Build Something Bigger



We are seeking a talented video editor to join our growing content team.



You will be working with content from Daniel Moncada (Leonel Salamanca from Breaking Bad and Better Call Saul), Sarge Slays, and other streamers on Daniel's team. Content includes gaming, livestream highlights, behind the scenes footage, events, brand partnerships, podcasts, lifestyle content, and social media content.



This is an opportunity to work with recognizable personalities while helping build multiple brands across Twitch, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram,
, Kick, and other platforms.



Our ideal editor doesn't just edit videos. They live and breathe gaming, streaming, and internet culture. They understand the biggest creators, stay on top of new games, trends, 
s, and viral content, and know what makes viewers stop scrolling and keep watching.



Gaming is at the heart of what we do, so we need someone who genuinely understands the gaming and livestreaming space. You'll be expected to stay current on new games, industry news, content trends, emerging creators, and the latest editing styles so you can bring fresh ideas that help our content stand out.



A Long Term Opportunity



We want to be upfront about this position.



This role will begin as an entry level position within our team. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us, not someone looking for a senior level salary on day one.



As you prove your creativity, reliability, communication, and ability to produce high performing content, you'll have opportunities for:



• Increased hours



• Higher compensation



• Performance bonuses



• Additional responsibilities



• Working with more streamers and personalities



• Growing into one of our lead editors as our team expands



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long term career with our team and grow alongside our creators.



Responsibilities



• Create engaging short form content for TikTok, Reels, Shorts,
, Instagram, and YouTube.



• Edit long form YouTube content.



• Create highlight reels from livestreams.



• Add captions, graphics, sound effects, transitions, music, and motion effects.



• Organize and manage video assets.



• Create thumbnail concepts when needed.



• Work directly with management to execute content strategies.



• Assist with multiple streamers and brands as the team grows.



• Bring fresh ideas and stay ahead of current trends within the gaming and creator space.



What We're Looking For



• Strong understanding of viral short form content.



• Passion for gaming and a solid understanding of livestreaming culture.



• Keeps up with the latest games, creators, internet culture, 
s, industry news, and social media trends.



• Understands what makes content go viral and knows how to create videos that capture attention and keep viewers engaged.



• Can edit gaming, entertainment, lifestyle, podcast, IRL, and behind the scenes content while adapting to each creator's unique style.



• Knows how to identify the best 
nts from long livestreams and turn them into engaging clips.



• Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar software.



• Fast turnaround times.



• Reliable communication.



• Self motivated and able to work independently.



• Willing to accept feedback, continue learning, and grow with the team.



Bonus Points



• You are an active gamer.



• You regularly watch Twitch, YouTube Gaming, Kick, or other livestreaming platforms.



• You have experience editing content for streamers or gaming creators.



• You have experience creating thumbnails and graphics.



• You understand YouTube analytics, audience retention, and social media trends.



• You use AI tools to improve your editing workflow and efficiency.



Application Instructions



Please include:



1. Your expected hourly rate or monthly salary.



2. How many hours you are available each week.



3. A link to your portfolio.



4. Examples of your best short form edits.



5. Examples of gaming or livestream content, if available.



6. Your favorite creator or streamer to watch online and why.



7. Begin your application with the word SALAMANCA so we know you read the entire posting.



Required Editing Challenge



As part of the application process, all applicants who wish to be considered for this position must complete the editing challenge below.



We have provided a Dropbox folder containing a variety of raw footage from Daniel Moncada and our team.







Don't just choose the first clip you see. Take the time to review the footage and select the 
nt that you believe has the best potential to become a viral short.



We want to see how you think as a creator, not just as an editor.



Create a 30 to 60 second short form video that captures attention immediately and keeps viewers engaged from start to finish.



Remember, Daniel is best known for playing Leonel Salamanca in Breaking Bad and Better Call Saul. His personality, expressions, and on camera presence are a huge part of his brand. When appropriate, lean into that identity while creating content that feels modern and optimized for today's social media platforms.



Show us your ability to:



• Find the best 
nt.



• Create a compelling hook within the first few seconds.



• Keep viewers engaged with strong pacing.



• Use captions, sound effects, music, zooms, graphics, and other creative editing techniques effectively.



• Create a video that people would stop scrolling to watch, engage with, and share.



There is no single correct edit. We want to see your creativity, decision making, storytelling, and understanding of audience retention. Surprise us.



When you submit your edit, also include 2 to 3 sentences explaining:



• Why you chose that particular clip.



• What strategy you used to maximize viewer retention and engagement.



Submission Deadline



All submissions must be received by Friday, July 10, 2026.



After the submission deadline, we will carefully review every completed submission and select the top 3 to 5 editors to move forward to the next stage of the interview process.



Every applicant who completes the editing challenge will be given full consideration. We are looking for the editor who best understands our creators, our audience, and our vision.



If you currently work as part of an editing team or agency, we are not opposed to bringing on more than one editor if we find multiple candidates who are a great fit.



Final Notes



Multiple submissions are welcome and encouraged.



If you'd like to showcase different editing styles, creative approaches, or multiple viral concepts, feel free to submit more than one edit. This is your opportunity to show us the full range of your creativity and abilities.



Don't be afraid to think outside the box. We appreciate editors who bring fresh ideas, take creative risks, and understand how to create content that stands out in today's fast moving social media landscape.



Our goal is to build one of the best creator media teams in gaming and entertainment, and we're looking for people who want to grow with us for years to come.



Best of luck. We can't wait to see what you create!

title: High-Performance Executive Assistant
description:
This is not a traditional Executive Assistant role.



We are looking for a high-performance operator who can combine data intelligence with operational execution and work directly alongside a fast-moving, visionary leader.



This role is for someone who can bring structure to data, clarity to decisions, and execution to leadership initiatives.



If you thrive in fast environments, think analytically, and operate with ownership, keep reading.



Who We Are:



DAP Brands is a community of high performers building businesses that create real impact.



Our leadership team moves quickly, thinks strategically, and expects people to take responsibility rather than wait for instructions.



We value:

• Speed

• Accountability

• Emotional maturity

• Precision

• Ownership

• Loyalty to the mission (not ego)



What This Role Really Is:



This role combines Data Analysis + Executive Operations.



Your first responsibility is to bring order to data across the organization: Cleaning, structuring, and translating it into clear insights.



Once the data foundation is organized, you will operate as a high-level executive, helping leadership execute faster and smarter.



You will help:



• Clean, organize, and analyze business data

• Turn raw data into meaningful reports and insights

• Support leadership with decision-ready information

• Protect your leader’s time and priorities

• Enforce accountability across leadership initiatives

• Translate strategy into structured execution

• Identify problems before they become fires

• Move initiatives forward without constant direction

• Bring clarity to complex situations



You will sit close to leadership.

You will see how decisions are made.

You must handle that with professionalism, discretion, and maturity.



What This Role Is NOT



This role is not for someone who:



• Needs constant praise or reassurance

• Struggles with direct feedback

• Prefers slow corporate environments

• Gets overwhelmed by changing priorities

• Waits for instructions instead of solving problems

• Is uncomfortable working with data and systems

• Frequently job hops every year



We operate in a high-accountability environment.



If you need tone cushioning or excessive structure, this will likely feel uncomfortable.



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days):



Within your first 90 days, you:



• Organize and clean key business data sets

• Create structured reporting for leadership decisions

• Build dashboards or reports that bring visibility to operations

• Run leadership meetings with clear structure and follow-through

• Anticipate your leader’s needs before they are spoken

• Track priorities and ensure accountability across teams

• Bring solutions instead of just raising issues

• Operate calmly and clearly under pressure



The Profile That Thrives Here



You likely:



• Have experience in data analysis, reporting, or business analytics

• Are comfortable working with spreadsheets, dashboards, and structured data

• Have supported a founder or senior executive before

• Have stayed 3+ years in at least one meaningful role

• Enjoy solving complex operational problems

• Can build systems and workflows from scratch

• Communicate clearly and directly

• Are emotionally regulated and professional under pressure

• Think in outcomes and insights, not just tasks



You are someone who:



• Notices patterns others miss

• Brings clarity where others see chaos

• Moves things forward without being asked twice



Compensation & Growth:



This role offers:



• Competitive compensation aligned with performance

• Direct exposure to executive decision-making

• The opportunity to shape internal systems and operations

• Long-term growth as the company scales



At DAP Brands, we reward impact and ownership, not just tenure.



Final Note



This role is for someone who wants to build, solve, and operate at a high level.



If you enjoy working with data, solving operational problems, and supporting leadership execution, this could be an excellent fit.



If you're looking for a comfortable, slow-paced corporate role, this probably isn't it.



But if you want to operate at a high level and help build something meaningful, apply on our website 
/careers and write MAVERICK before your name.

title: Full-Time Real Estate, Renovation & AI Operations Assistant
description:
Job Title: Full-Time Real Estate, Renovation & AI Operations Assistant



We are hiring a full-time Real Estate, Renovation & AI Operations Assistant based in the Philippines to support a growing Canadian real estate, rental, renovation, and property services business.



This is a long-term remote role for someone who is organized, detail-oriented, reliable, coachable, and comfortable using technology and AI tools to work faster, stay organized, and create better results.



This role is not only about completing tasks. We are looking for someone who can help organize the business, manage follow-ups, research opportunities, create systems, support marketing, help with client communication, and eventually become a key operations assistant.



The work will involve supporting a real estate brokerage, rental clients, property investors, renovation projects, rental turnovers, property searches, lead generation, social media, basic website/content support, market research, and business development.



Main Responsibilities:



* Research landlords, property managers, investors, real estate contacts, and potential business opportunities

* Build and organize lead lists in Google Sheets and CRM systems

* Help manage rental inquiries, real estate leads, and client follow-ups

* Draft follow-up
s, WhatsApp messages,
/Instagram replies, and client updates

* Interpret voice notes, rough notes, screenshots, and messages, then turn them into clear action plans

* Track leads, quotes, tasks, follow-ups, deadlines, and pending items

* Help prepare and format renovation quotes, project summaries, client notes, and simple reports

* Assist with property searches and organize property information for clients

* Research U.S. markets for rental turnover, property management, landlord services, and investor opportunities

* Organize before-and-after renovation photos and videos

* Help prepare social media posts, captions, reels, short videos, and basic marketing content

* Assist with basic video editing for social media or be willing to learn

* Help organize
, Instagram, WhatsApp, and other marketing channels

* Help create repeatable systems, checklists, templates, and standard operating procedures

* Send daily work summaries with completed tasks, pending tasks, questions, and opportunities

* Help turn business ideas, voice notes, and rough instructions into organized tasks and action plans



Website, Content & SEO Support:



We may be launching a few simple websites and landing pages over time. You do not need to be a website expert or SEO specialist, but basic experience or willingness to learn is a strong advantage.



Helpful experience includes:



* Basic WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, Shopify, GoHighLevel, or similar website tools

* Helping upload or organize website content

* Creating or editing simple landing pages

* Writing or organizing service pages, blog posts, FAQs, or local business content

* Basic understanding of SEO, keywords, headings, page titles, and meta descriptions

* Organizing photos, videos, testimonials, and before-and-after examples for websites

* Helping research competitors, service areas, and content ideas

* Using AI tools to help draft and improve website content



Again, this is not a web developer role. We are mainly looking for someone who is organized, willing to learn, and able to use AI and instructions to help support website and content projects.



AI and Technology:



We actively use AI tools to improve speed, organization, writing, research, marketing, content creation, and decision-making. Experience using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Canva AI, or other AI tools is a strong advantage.



You do not need to be an AI expert, but you must be open to learning and using AI as part of your daily workflow.



The goal is not to replace people with AI. The goal is to help the right person become more productive, more valuable, and more capable.



You may be asked to complete training, watch courses, learn new tools, use AI tools, and help implement better systems into the business over time.



Training and Working Style:



This role will include hands-on training, especially in the beginning. You will not be expected to know everything on day one.



You should be comfortable learning through voice notes, screen recordings, written instructions, examples, checklists, feedback, live communication, and online courses.



Some work will involve reviewing notes together, screen sharing, learning AI workflows, improving systems, organizing tasks, and turning training into repeatable processes.



The right person should be coachable, curious, organized, and willing to improve over time. We are looking for someone who can grow into the role, not someone who only waits for exact instructions.



Required Skills:



* Strong written English

* Excellent attention to detail

* Reliable internet connection

* Good Google Sheets and Google Drive skills

* Comfortable with Gmail, WhatsApp,
, Instagram, Canva, and online research

* Comfortable learning AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Canva AI

* Comfortable with basic content creation and social media support

* Comfortable with basic video editing or willing to learn

* Interested in learning website and SEO basics

* Able to follow instructions carefully

* Able to ask smart questions when something is unclear

* Able to turn notes into organized tasks

* Able to create simple checklists and improve processes over time

* Able to send clear daily work summaries

* Able to work independently after receiving training

* Able to take feedback and improve quickly



Experience That Is a Major Advantage:



* Real estate admin

* Property management

* Construction or renovation admin

* Lead generation

* CRM work

* Social media posting

* Short-form video editing

* Canva design

* Basic website support

* Basic SEO or content writing

* Google Business Profile support

* Executive assistant experience

* AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Canva AI

* Online course learning and implementation

* Experience helping organize a small business or entrepreneur



Schedule:



This is a full-time role, approximately 40 hours per week.



Because this is a hands-on role, strong overlap with Toronto, Canada time is important, especially during the first 30–60 days of training.



Preferred schedule during training:



* 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM Toronto time for live overlap

* This is approximately 8:00 PM to 12:00 AM Philippines time

* Remaining hours can be completed before or after this window, depending on what works best



Some tasks will require live communication, screen sharing, training, reviewing notes, organizing tasks, learning AI tools, and improving systems together.



Please only apply if you are comfortable with regular overlap with Toronto morning hours.



Pay:



Starting pay is $500–$600 USD per month for full-time work, depending on experience, written English, attention to detail, availability for Toronto time overlap, AI comfort, willingness to learn, and ability to work independently.



This will begin with a paid trial. Compensation can increase over time based on reliability, speed, quality of work, communication, ownership, ability to learn, and ability to create results without constant supervision.



We are looking for someone long-term who wants to grow with the business, improve their skills, and become more valuable over time.



To Apply, Please Answer the Following:



1. What real estate, property management, construction, renovation, admin, marketing, or executive assistant experience do you have?



2. What tools have you used before? Examples: Google Sheets, Gmail, Canva, CRM tools, WhatsApp,
, Instagram, Trello, ClickUp, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, video editing tools, or website tools.



3. Have you used AI tools before? If yes, which ones and how have you used them for work?



4. Do you have any basic experience with websites, landing pages, SEO, blogs, social media content, or online content? Beginner experience is okay.



5. This role starts at $500–$600 USD per month for full-time work, depending on experience, written English, attention to detail, availability for Toronto time overlap, AI comfort, willingness to learn, and ability to work independently. Is this range acceptable to you? Also, what hours can you work in Philippines time?



6. Please write the word “Forestwood” in the first line of your application so I know you read this carefully.



7. Please include a short sample follow-up message to a client, customer, lead, or business contact who asked about a service but has not replied yet.



This role is best for someone who wants stable, long-term work, enjoys learning, and wants to grow with a business.



We are looking for someone reliable, organized, coachable, practical, and interested in real estate, renovation, marketing, content, systems, and AI.



The right person should be willing to learn, use and work together with AI, improve systems, support projects, create content, and become more valuable over time.

title: Airbnb PriceLabs Specialist / STR Revenue Manager
description:
Airbnb PriceLabs Specialist / STR Revenue Manager



We are hiring an experienced Airbnb / STR Pricing Specialist who is very strong with PriceLabs, short-term rental comps, market research, and revenue management.



We are a new luxury short-term rental management company. Our founding team previously built and sold a large Airbnb arbitrage business, and now we are building a new company focused on premium/luxury vacation rentals.



To start, we only have 1 active property that needs pricing support. However, we are actively growing and will need help running comps, building revenue reports, reviewing new property opportunities, and managing pricing as we add more listings.



This is a part-time role to start, but we want someone who can grow with us. If you are truly good, reliable, and proactive, we are open to increasing pay and responsibility as the company scales.



We are not looking for a basic Airbnb VA. We need someone who knows how to actually use PriceLabs properly and understands how pricing strategy affects revenue.



Main Responsibilities:



* Manage and optimize pricing inside PriceLabs

* Set and adjust base price, minimum price, and maximum price

* Customize PriceLabs settings based on seasonality, demand, booking pace, and market conditions

* Adjust minimum stay rules, gap night rules, orphan night rules, date-specific overrides, and occupancy-based adjustments

* Run Airbnb, VRBO, and market comps for each property

* Use AirDNA and other tools to research market performance

* Track local events, holidays, concerts, sports events, festivals, school breaks, and demand spikes

* Monitor ADR, occupancy, RevPAR, booking pace, lead time, and market demand

* Identify underpriced and overpriced dates

* Recommend pricing changes based on data

* Help create simple revenue reports for our internal team

* Research competitor listings and top-performing properties

* Help build our revenue management SOPs as we grow



Requirements:



* Must have strong experience using PriceLabs

* Must know how to customize PriceLabs settings, not just turn on dynamic pricing

* Must understand Airbnb / STR pricing strategy

* Must know how to run proper comps

* Experience with AirDNA is strongly preferred

* Strong Google Sheets skills

* Strong written English

* Detail-oriented and analytical

* Proactive about finding events, demand spikes, and pricing opportunities

* Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar

* Experience pricing multiple STR properties is a plus

* Experience with luxury or high-revenue STR properties is a plus

* Experience with Hostaway or another PMS/channel manager is a plus



We are looking for someone who is confident making pricing recommendations. We do not want someone who only follows basic PriceLabs suggestions. We want someone who can look at the market, understand demand, review comps, and help us maximize revenue.



To Apply:



Please answer these questions:



1. How long have you used PriceLabs?

2. How many STR properties have you priced at one time?

3. What PriceLabs settings and customizations do you know how to use?

4. Have you used AirDNA before? Please explain your experience.

5. How do you run comps for a short-term rental property?

6. How do you track local events and adjust pricing around them?

7. What metrics do you look at when d
 if pricing should change?

8. Have you priced luxury or high-revenue STR properties before?

9. What PMS or channel managers have you used?

10. What is your expected monthly pay in PHP for a part-time role to start?



To confirm you read the full post, please include your favorite animal in the subject line.



Applications without the favorite animal in the subject line will not be reviewed.

You must handle that with professionalism, discretion, and maturity.



What This Role Is NOT



This role is not for someone who:



• Needs constant praise or reassurance

• Struggles with direct feedback

• Prefers slow corporate environments

• Gets overwhelmed by changing priorities

• Waits for instructions instead of solving problems

• Is uncomfortable working with data and systems

• Frequently job hops every year



We operate in a high-accountability environment.



If you need tone cushioning or excessive structure, this will likely feel uncomfortable.



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days):



Within your first 90 days, you:



• Organize and clean key business data sets

• Create structured reporting for leadership decisions

• Build dashboards or reports that bring visibility to operations

• Run leadership meetings with clear structure and follow-through

• Anticipate your leader’s needs before they are spoken

• Track priorities and ensure accountability across teams

• Bring solutions instead of just raising issues

• Operate calmly and clearly under pressure



The Profile That Thrives Here



You likely:



• Have experience in data analysis, reporting, or business analytics

• Have supported a founder or senior executive before

• Have stayed 3+ years in at least one meaningful role

• Enjoy solving complex operational problems

• Can build systems and workflows from scratch

• Communicate clearly and directly

• Are emotionally regulated and professional under pressure

• Think in outcomes and insights, not just tasks



You are someone who:



• Notices patterns others miss

• Brings clarity where others see chaos

• Moves things forward without being asked twice



Compensation & Growth:



This role offers:



• Competitive compensation aligned with performance

• Direct exposure to executive decision-making

• The opportunity to shape internal systems and operations

• Long-term growth as the company scales



At DAP Brands, we reward impact and ownership, not just tenure.



Final Note



This role is for someone who wants to build, solve, and operate at a high level.



If you enjoy working with data, solving operational problems, and supporting leadership execution, this could be an excellent fit.



If you're looking for a comfortable, slow-paced corporate role, this probably isn't it.



But if you want to operate at a high level and help build something meaningful, apply on our website 
/careers and write MAVERICK before your name.

The Case Manager will be responsible for handling a caseload of pre-litigation files from intake through settlement or trial support. This role is central to ensuring that each client’s case progresses smoothly, efficiently, and in full compliance with California legal requirements.



Key Responsibilities:



Case Intake & Client Onboarding



Conduct initial intake calls with potential clients at any time

Explain the representation process, gather facts, and assess case viability

Ensure all necessary intake forms, authorizations, and documents are completed

Open and set up new case files in case management system



File & Case Management



Serve as primary point of contact for clients throughout the life of the case

Maintain organized and up-to-date digital files using firm case management software

Track all case deadlines, SOLs, medical treatment status, lien info, and key events

Draft letters of representation and send to insurance companies, employers, and medical providers

Coordinate communications with insurance adjusters, medical providers, and other parties



Medical & Records Management



Assist clients in locating appropriate medical providers

Monitor medical treatment and keep detailed notes of client progress

Request and follow up on medical records and bills

Organize medical records chronologically and summarize treatment history

Track and negotiate medical liens (e.g., MedPay, health insurance, hospital liens, third-party)

Insurance & Settlement Support

Submit demands with supporting documentation under attorney supervision

Track offers, counteroffers, and communicate updates to clients

Prepare case summaries for settlement negotiations

Draft settlement memos, disbursement breakdowns, and closing documentation



Required Qualifications:



Minimum 2 years of experience in personal injury law (case manager, paralegal, or similar role)

Knowledge of California personal injury laws and procedures

Strong understanding of medical terminology and records

Excellent communication and client service skills

Strong time management and organizational abilities

Proficiency in legal case management software (e.g., Filevine)

Fluent in English; bilingual in Spanish is a strong plus

Familiarity with pre-litigation and litigation processes

title: Podcast & YouTube Video/Audio Editor
description:
I record a weekly interview that I repurpose for YouTube. I'm looking for a detail-oriented editor who can own audio and video production so I can consistently publish a polished recording to podcast and YouTube formats and so I can stay focused on recording and strategy.



The work:

- 1 episode per week, 45-60 minutes raw, recorded remotely (split-screen interview format)

- Edit in Descript (my stack) or your preferred tool: clean audio, remove filler words and false starts, tighten pacing, cut pre/post-interview chatter

- Build the YouTube edit: 15-45 second cold open clip from the interview, drop in my provided logo sting and lower-third templates, hard cut to end screen after my closing CTA

- Produce the audio-only version with intro/outro bumpers (assets provided, you assemble)

- Deliver final MP4, audio file, and .srt captions file

- Turnaround: 3 business days from receiving the raw recording

- Manage the episode queue and a database of produced files



Style reference: Lenny's Podcast on YouTube. Clean, conversational, no flashy transitions, zooms, or sound effects. If your portfolio is gaming montages or short-form hype edits, this isn't the right fit.



What I handle myself: thumbnails, show notes, metadata.



What I'm looking for:

- Experience editing interview or B2B podcast content (send 1-2 links to episodes you've edited)

- Good spoken and written English

- Reliable, communicates proactively, comfortable using AI tools (Claude, Descript AI features)

- Sense of humor a plus



We'll start at roughly 4 hours per week per episode and grow from there. One round of revisions per episode is included in scope.

title: Product Lister with Ad Creative Skills - US Fashion Shopify Store
description:
## About this role



We run fast-growing US women's fashion stores on Shopify and we are looking for a careful, detail-driven Product Lister who can also design ad creatives. Listing is the core job. We hand you a prepared product list and you turn it into clean, launch-ready Shopify listings the ads team can run the same day. Research is done upstream, so your focus is accuracy and consistency, not guesswork.



The second hat: as listing volume allows, you produce static and video ad creatives from our briefs and templates. Not pretty brand work. Scroll-stopping ad creative built around proven hooks. Workload is light at the start, which is exactly why we want one person who can do both. As we grow, this role can split toward whichever side you are strongest at.



## What you'll do



Listing (core):



- Import each product into Shopify using poky, DSers, AutoDS, Zendrop, or CJ from a Google Sheet/Notion page we prepare

- Polish the product copy in clear US English and add the correct size and measurement charts (US sizing)

- Build each listing from our template (variants, collections) and create the internal product link

- Self-check against the QA checklist

- Flag any product you cannot list correctly (missing size chart, poor images) instead of guessing



Creative (second hat):



- Produce static and video ad variations from our briefs and template (Canva or Photoshop, CapCut)

- Repurpose UGC into ad-ready cuts

- File everything in the creative library with clear naming

- Iterate on winners fast when we tell you what is scaling



## What we're looking for



- Hands-on Shopify product creation: variants, size charts, collections

- Experience with an import tool (DSers, AutoDS, Zendrop, CJ)

- Strong written US English; clean, consistent product copy

- Canva or Photoshop plus basic video editing (CapCut or similar); ad creative samples a big plus

- Detail over speed, follows a checklist exactly, asks before guessing

- Reliable and responsive for async handoffs

- Reads every instruction before starting (open your reply to this job posting with the word periscope)



## What you can expect from us



- On-time pay, every time

- Clear templates and SOPs for both listings and creatives, so you are never inventing the format

- Fast answers from us when you flag a problem

- A long-term role that grows with us: lead lister, or full-time creative designer, within 6 months



## How to apply



Send a short intro in English with:



1. One example listing you built (link or screenshots) and which import tools you use

2. Two or three ad creatives or designs you made (any format)

3. Your hourly ask and how you would handle a product with no size chart



Applications without a personal intro and work samples will not be considered.

title: Phone Appointment Setter
description:
We are looking for a reliable, fast-responding Phone Appointment Setter based in the Philippines to help us call inbound leads and book appointments.



This is a speed-to-lead role, which means your main responsibility is to call new leads as soon as they come in. When a lead submits their information, you will receive an inbound notification through the GoHighLevel or LeadConnector mobile app. You must call the lead within the first 5 minutes of receiving the notification.



You will call leads directly through the GoHighLevel/LeadConnector app, so you do not need your own phone number. You will need a smartphone, reliable internet, and the ability to keep app notifications on during your shift.



Schedule:



We are hiring for two different 8-hour shifts outside of standard U.S. 9 AM–5 PM business hours.



Assuming U.S. Central Time, the available shifts in Philippine Time are:



Shift 1: 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM Philippine Time

Shift 2: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM Philippine Time



Please mention in your application which shift you are applying for.



Important Note About Workload



This is a part-time role because you need to be available and “on call” during your shift, but there will likely not be a high volume of actual work.



Most days, the actual calling time will be less than 30 minutes per day. Your job is to stay available, monitor notifications, respond quickly when leads come in, call them, and book the appointment.



Responsibilities:



Your main responsibilities will include:



- Monitoring GoHighLevel/LeadConnector notifications during your shift

- Calling new inbound leads within 5 minutes

- Speaking with leads in a professional and friendly way

- Booking appointments using our calendar system

- Updating lead status and notes inside GoHighLevel

- Following a simple call script and appointment-setting process

- Sending follow-up messages when needed

- Staying responsive and available during your scheduled shift



Requirements:



We are looking for someone who is:



- Fluent in English

- Comfortable speaking with U.S.-based leads

- Clear, professional, and easy to understand on the phone

- Able to communicate in a natural, conversational style that feels familiar to U.S. customers

- Reliable and highly responsive

- Able to call leads quickly after receiving notifications

- Comfortable using mobile apps like GoHighLevel or LeadConnector

- Organized and able to take basic notes after each call

- Available for one of the listed shifts

- Has a quiet work environment and stable internet connection



Strong English speaking ability is very important for this role because you will be speaking directly with U.S. leads over the phone.



Apps You Will Need:



You must be willing to download and use:



GoHighLevel mobile app

LeadConnector mobile app



Training will be provided if you have not used these before.



Pay:



Pay is $250 USD per month.



This is ideal for someone who wants steady part-time work where they are available during their shift, but the actual call volume is expected to be light.



How to Apply:



Please include the following in your application:



Which shift you are applying for:

6:00 AM – 2:00 PM Philippine Time

2:00 PM – 10:00 PM Philippine Time



- A short summary of your appointment setting, phone sales, customer service, or VA experience.

- Confirmation that you can call leads within 5 minutes of receiving a notification.

- Confirmation that you have a smartphone, stable internet, and a quiet place to take calls.



Please attach a short voice recording introducing yourself so we can hear your English speaking ability and phone presence. In this voice recording, give an intro of yourself and why you think you are a good fit for the role. If you are unable to attach the voice recording to the job application, please
 it to me: 





We are looking for someone reliable, professional, and fast to respond. If you are a strong communicator and can stay available during your shift, we would love to hear from you.

title: Amazon Product Research Virtual Assistant (SellerAmp SAS & Keepa)
description:
Position Overview



We are looking for a detail-oriented and motivated Amazon Product Research Virtual Assistant to help source profitable Online Arbitrage products using SellerAmp SAS, Keepa, and proven reverse sourcing techniques.



This is not a basic product research position. We are looking for someone who enjoys digging through Amazon listings, analyzing data, and finding hidden opportunities that other sellers overlook.



If you enjoy research, problem-solving, and learning Amazon Online Arbitrage, this position is for you.



Responsibilities



Your primary responsibility is to find profitable products that meet our sourcing criteria.



Daily tasks include:



Research products using SellerAmp SAS and Keepa.

Reverse source through Amazon seller storefronts.

Analyze 0-star and low-review seller accounts to discover new sourcing opportunities.

Continue reverse sourcing from seller to seller to build an endless pipeline of products.

Evaluate every product for profitability before submitting.

Calculate profits while including estimated FBM shipping costs.

Verify pricing history, sales history, competition, and Buy Box stability.

Submit qualified leads using our sourcing spreadsheet.

Required Skills



Applicants should have experience with or be willing to learn:



SellerAmp SAS

Keepa

Amazon Seller Central (preferred)

Product sourcing

Online Arbitrage

Reverse sourcing

Excel or Google Sheets

Strong attention to detail

Product Evaluation Requirements



Every product submitted must be evaluated using the following criteria:



Profit

Target a minimum profit of $10+ for FBM products whenever possible.

Higher profits are always preferred.

Shipping

Include estimated FBM shipping costs in every calculation.

Assume a minimum shipping cost of $5–$7 unless the item clearly ships for less.

Keepa Analysis



Review:



Price history

Sales Rank history

Offer Count

Seller history

Buy Box history

Amazon presence

Product trends

Competition



Avoid products with unhealthy competition or unstable pricing.



Reverse Sourcing Process



This is the primary sourcing strategy you'll use.



Find a product.

Open the Amazon Offer Listings.

Locate 0-star or low-review sellers.

Open their storefront.

Analyze every product they sell using SellerAmp SAS.

If another 0-star seller appears, repeat the process.

Continue sourcing endlessly until profitable products are found.



The goal is to uncover products that most sellers never discover.



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who:



Pays attention to details.

Thinks independently.

Enjoys solving problems.

Doesn't stop after finding one product.

Can source for hours while maintaining quality.

Understands that consistency produces results.

Performance Expectations



Successful Virtual Assistants consistently:



Submit high-quality leads.

Follow our sourcing criteria.

Analyze Keepa before making recommendations.

Look beyond obvious products.

Find hidden opportunities through reverse sourcing.



Quality is more important than quantity.



Growth Opportunity



As you become more experienced with our sourcing system, you'll gain a deeper understanding of Amazon Online Arbitrage, product analysis, and advanced sourcing strategies.



We're looking for someone interested in growing with our business over the long term.



If you're motivated, eager to learn, and excited about finding profitable products through data-driven research, we'd love to hear from you.

We’re building more than a landscaping company—we’re building a scalable growth platform designed around strong systems, technology, disciplined follow-up, exceptional customer experiences, and continuous improvement.



Our goal is not simply to “do more marketing.” We are building a repeatable Growth Machine that consistently generates qualified leads, converts opportunities into profitable work, expands existing customer relationships, and creates long-term enterprise value.



We’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us and become an important part of that system.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We’re looking for a highly organized, proactive, and results-oriented **Marketing & Lead Generation Coordinator** to help drive qualified lead generation and keep growth opportunities moving forward.



**This is not just a social media position.**



Your primary focus will be helping us create, capture, organize, track, and advance growth opportunities.



You’ll support lead generation campaigns, prospect outreach, customer reactivation, referral initiatives, quote follow-up, CRM organization, marketing execution, and growth reporting.



You’ll work directly with the owner and gradually take ownership of recurring lead generation and growth activities.



The right person will enjoy both sides of growth:



* Creating campaigns that generate demand

* Following through to make sure leads and opportunities do not fall through the cracks



WHAT YOU’LL DO



Lead Generation & Campaign Execution
